gloss: passerine bird of the family Zosteropidae
definitions: Any of the passerine birds of the family Zosteropidae, native to Africa, Asia, and Australasia, typically having a ring of tiny white feathers around their eyes.
A species of killifish (Oxyzygonectes dovii) of the family Anablepidae, native to Central America.
A kind of very strong whiskey.
